title.narrative: Strengthening the Global Influence and Outreach of the MAB Programme

description.narrative: This activity aims to reinforce the Man and the Biosphere (MAB) Programme’s visibility, credibility, and influence in global environmental governance and sustainability agendas. It will do so by combining strengthened participation in international policy processes, modernized data and knowledge systems, and targeted leadership in biodiversity education. The activity will position MAB as a key scientific and policy interface by improving how biosphere reserve data is collected, shared, and used; ensuring UNESCO’s coordinated presence in major global environmental negotiations; and leveraging biosphere reserves as learning laboratories for biodiversity education with strong and committed youth engagement.
